aaa_enabled.summary: Configure centralized RADIUS or TACACS+ authentication servers under authentication settings.
aaa_enabled.notes: Remote authentication servers must be configured in the WebAdmin GUI under Configure > Authentication > Servers.

secure_vty_transport.notes: Ensure that the Telnet check box is unchecked for all zones (e.g. LAN, WAN, DMZ) in the WebAdmin GUI under Administration > Device Access.

vty_idle_timeout.summary: Configure WebAdmin/Console session inactivity timeout to 10 minutes (600 seconds) or less.
vty_idle_timeout.notes: Set the administration bypass timeout in the WebAdmin GUI under Administration > Admin and user settings > Access settings > Admin console timeout.

enable_secret_encrypted.summary: Ensure administrative account passwords are encrypted.
enable_secret_encrypted.notes: Sophos Firewall local passwords are automatically hashed and encrypted in system configuration databases.

no_default_snmp_community.summary: Remove default SNMP community names public and private.
no_default_snmp_community.notes: Disable or delete default communities in the WebAdmin GUI under Administration > SNMP > Community.

http_server_disabled.summary: Disable the unencrypted WebAdmin HTTP server redirect or access.
http_server_disabled.notes: Configure the WebAdmin access settings under Administration > Admin and user settings > WebAdmin settings.

ssh_version_2.summary: Secure SSH settings and restrict zone access permissions.
ssh_version_2.notes: Ensure remote SSH access is enabled and restricted to trusted networks under Administration > Device Access.

logging_enabled.summary: Configure a remote syslog server target.
logging_enabled.notes: Add and enable syslog server settings in the WebAdmin GUI under System services > Log settings > Syslog servers.

management_acl.summary: Configure Device Access control rules to restrict administration services (SSH/HTTPS) to specific hosts or subnets.
management_acl.notes: Go to WebAdmin GUI > Administration > Device Access > Local Service ACL Exception Rule to add network/IP restrictions.

login_banner.summary: Enable and configure a pre-login warning banner message.
login_banner.notes: Enable and configure the login disclaimer text in the WebAdmin GUI under Administration > Admin and user settings > Login disclaimer settings.

password_min_length.summary: Enforce local user password complexity requirements.
password_min_length.notes: Configure complexity and minimum password length under Administration > Password complexity settings.

ntp_configured.notes: Add NTP servers and enable time synchronization in the WebAdmin GUI under Administration > Time.

no_write_snmp_community.summary: Configure SNMP communities to readonly access only.
no_write_snmp_community.notes: Verify SNMP community access rights under Administration > SNMP.
